props.quote:
I was nervous about the sailing. By Wednesday I was the one asking to stay out longer.

The instructors are endlessly patient, and the boat I helped build is still in the harbour fleet. I go and look at it most weekends.
props.name: Leo Marsh

props.quote: Every summer we send a few of our young members. They come back steadier in a boat and far more curious about how one is put together.
props.name: Ellie Ward

props.quote: We fund a lot of projects. This is the one people stop us in the street to talk about.
props.name: Ruth Alder

props.quote: Five days, one boat, and a group of strangers who are now my closest friends.
props.name: Jonah Reed
